## 1.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

airports <- read_csv(
  "airports.csv",
  col_select = c(IATA_CODE, CITY, STATE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)
)

airlines <- read_csv("airlines.csv")

aux <- data.frame(
  DESTINATION_AIRPORT = character(),
  total_atraso = numeric(),
  quantidade = numeric()
)

ler_parte <- function(x, pos) {
  x <- x[substr(x$DESTINATION_AIRPORT, 1, 1) != "1", ]
  x <- na.omit(x)

  resumo <- x %>%
    group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) %>%
    summarise(
      total_atraso = sum(ARRIVAL_DELAY),
      quantidade = n()
    )

  aux <<- rbind(aux, resumo)
}

read_csv_chunked(
  "flights.csv",
  col_types = cols_only(
    DESTINATION_AIRPORT = col_character(),
    ARRIVAL_DELAY = col_double()
  ),
  chunk_size = 1000000,
  callback = SideEffectChunkCallback$new(ler_parte)
)

flights <- aux %>%
  group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) %>%
  summarise(
    total_atraso = sum(total_atraso),
    quantidade = sum(quantidade)
  ) %>%
  mutate(atraso_medio = total_atraso / quantidade)
```

## 2.

a)  A chave em `flights` é `DESTINATION_AIRPORT`.

b)  A chave em `airports` é `IATA_CODE`.

c)  Não aparecem aeroportos presentes em `flights` e ausentes em `airports`.

```{r}
anti_join(
  flights,
  airports,
  by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE")
)
```

d)  A operação usada é `left_join`. Como as chaves possuem nomes diferentes, elas precisam ser indicadas no argumento `by`.

e)  

```{r}
flights <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    airports %>% select(IATA_CODE, CITY, STATE),
    by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE")
  )
```

## 3.

```{r}
airports %>%
  group_by(STATE) %>%
  summarise(aeroportos = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(aeroportos))
```

## 4.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)

dados_mapa <- flights %>%
  left_join(
    airports %>% select(IATA_CODE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE),
    by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE")
  )

mapa_eua <- map_data("state")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = mapa_eua,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "white",
    color = "gray"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = dados_mapa,
    aes(
      x = LONGITUDE,
      y = LATITUDE,
      color = atraso_medio
    ),
    size = 2
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Atraso médio"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(1.3) +
  theme_minimal()
```
